prompt: Create a low-resolution, heavily cropped surveillance-style image centered on a single adult woman standing indoors against a gray concrete or stone wall while holding the handle of a simple silver metal hand truck/dolly. The woman has dark brown shoulder-length slightly wavy hair, a neutral serious expression, and is facing forward with her body angled very slightly left. She wears a long dark brown or black cardigan/coat over a dark ankle-length skirt or dress, with light-colored flat shoes visible at the bottom. The dolly has exactly one visible U-shaped vertical handle, two horizontal crossbars, and two small black wheels near the floor. The subject appears as a small vertical crop in the center of a large plain black canvas, with lots of empty black space around the image. Use grainy compressed digital texture, muted colors, soft focus, and a candid CCTV-like look rather than polished photography. No text, no logos, no extra people, no added objects.
